message: Last week, we had a surprise power outage that turned into an unexpected family adventure. I gathered the kids, pulled out our flashlights and a couple of lanterns, and we set up a mini camp in the living room with snacks and board games. It was so cozy, we almost forgot we were in the dark! Now I’m thinking it’s a good idea to keep those power banks charged and have a few more fun ideas up my sleeve for next time. How do you make the best of a blackout?
